markets.optimal_book_rationale: Optimal book for this segment is 15 accounts/rep (11-20 band). We pick the largest book-size bucket where median revenue growth stays within 85% of the segment peak (40% in that band) and a bigger book no longer adds growth — that plateau is the data-driven target for headcount math. Segment avg PQR (prior quarter revenue per rep): $65K — the benchmark for whether a rep's book is revenue-heavy vs peers. Segment avg PCID: 20 accounts/rep — typical book size today; ideal PCID is the growth-optimal target, not the average.
